Incident report: API errors on Aug 11, 2026

Between 14:02 and 14:31 UTC, 12% of API requests failed with HTTP 502. A deploy at 14:02 removed the cache warmup step. The missing step left some API servers without ready cache data. Those servers returned HTTP 502 while they loaded required data on demand. We detected the higher error rate at 14:05 UTC and stopped the deploy rollout. We reverted the deploy at 14:27 UTC. Error rates returned to normal at 14:31 UTC. We restored the cache warmup step and added a release test for it. We apologize for the disruption.
